passing_final_head_checks.workflow: Market Translation Audit MTA-G0 gate readiness

merge_attempt.message: 2 of 2 required status checks are expected

reproduction: Close and reopen PR 210 without changing the branch head.
Wait for reopened-head MTA-G0, tiered FINAL_HEAD and generic tests workflows to complete PASS.
GitHub rejects the merge with two required status checks still expected.
why_not_correctable_inside_mta_scope: The GitHub connector does not expose the repository ruleset or branch-protection required-check context list.
The available repository evidence supplies only a ruleset hash, not independently reproducible ruleset bytes or a retrieval location.
Changing branch protection or required-check contexts is an external repository-governance action outside the bounded MTA audit packet.
Bypassing or weakening required checks would violate the approved plan and OVC branch discipline.
smallest_lawful_resolution: Provide an independently reproducible export or retrieval location for the active main-branch ruleset.
Identify the exact two required status-check context names and their expected GitHub App identities.
Correct the external ruleset only if those contexts are stale or mismatched, without weakening required assurance.
Re-run the exact required checks on the unchanged or newly lawful PR head, then resume with OVC CONTINUE.
rollback: No destructive rollback. Preserve PR 210 and all decision/evidence records. If the programme is abandoned, close PR 210 without deleting its branch and retain the blocker as the court record.
